verdict.rationale: Plausible's docs describe only aggregate, anonymous pageview/event analytics (custom events, funnels, goals) with no mention of account/company-level grouping, user identification, or CRM-style segmentation needed for B2B account analytics. Community evidence explicitly notes Plausible cannot even persist identity across days (plausible-comm-3), undermining any account-level rollup, and no custom-properties or company-dimension feature is documented anywhere in the pack.
